title: Trace energy under a constant Weil twist
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ of characteristic $p$, an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an isomorphism $\iota:\Qlb\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf C$ as in [def-weil-punctual-weights]. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme. For a constructible Weil sheaf $\mathcal H$ on $X_0$, $m\ge1$, and $y\in X_0(\mathbf F_{q^m})$, write $t_{\mathcal H,m}(y)=\operatorname{Tr}(F_y^{(m)}\mid\mathcal H_{\bar y})$, with the local operator of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace], and set $S_m(\mathcal H)=\sum_{y\in X_0(\mathbf F_{q^m})}|\iota t_{\mathcal H,m}(y)|^2$.
Let $\mathcal F$ be a constructible Weil sheaf on $X_0$, let $b\in\Qlb^\times$, and let $w\in\mathbf R$ satisfy $|\iota(b)|=q^{-w/2}$. For the constant twist $\mathcal B_b$ of [def-wf-constant-weil-twist], for every $m\ge1$ one has
$$S_m(\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal B_b)=q^{-mw}S_m(\mathcal F).$$
